[/et_pb_text][et_pb_text _builder_version=”4.16″ text_font=”Heebo||||||||” text_text_color=”#000000″ text_font_size=”17px” text_line_height=”1.9em” header_font=”Poppins|700||on|||||” header_text_align=”left” header_text_color=”#1E73B9″ header_font_size=”4.2vw” header_3_font=”||on||||||” header_3_text_align=”center” header_3_text_color=”#000000″ header_4_font=”||on||||||” header_4_text_align=”center” header_4_text_color=”#BB1C29″ header_4_font_size=”20px” header_4_line_height=”1.4em” width=”80%” width_tablet=”85%” width_phone=”95%” width_last_edited=”on|phone” module_alignment=”center” custom_padding=”25px||||false|false” text_font_size_tablet=”18px” text_font_size_phone=”15px” text_font_size_last_edited=”on|phone” header_font_size_tablet=”5vw” header_font_size_phone=”9vw” header_font_size_last_edited=”on|phone” header_4_font_size_tablet=”” header_4_font_size_phone=”5vw” header_4_font_size_last_edited=”on|phone” locked=”off” global_colors_info=”{}”]

A long-lasting and durable metal roof may be the best solution for your home or business.

[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][/et_pb_row][et_pb_row column_structure=”1_2,1_2″ _builder_version=”4.16″ _module_preset=”default” global_colors_info=”{}”][et_pb_column type=”1_2″ _builder_version=”4.16″ _module_preset=”default” global_colors_info=”{}”][et_pb_text disabled_on=”on|on|off” _builder_version=”4.16″ text_font=”Heebo||||||||” text_text_color=”#000000″ text_font_size=”17px” text_line_height=”1.9em” link_font=”|||on|||||” link_text_color=”#BB1C29″ header_font=”Poppins|700||on|||||” header_text_align=”center” header_text_color=”#1E73B9″ header_font_size=”5vw” text_orientation=”center” max_width=”850px” module_alignment=”center” text_font_size_tablet=”18px” text_font_size_phone=”15px” text_font_size_last_edited=”on|phone” header_font_size_tablet=”5vw” header_font_size_phone=”9vw” header_font_size_last_edited=”on|phone” locked=”off” global_colors_info=”{}”]

One of the most significant investments you will make in your lifetime is the place you call home, or for some of our clients, their business property. Your roof protects the rafters and walls beneath it, as well as the rest of the building structure. Typically, buyers check the age and condition of a roof on a home or business before putting out an offer. Keep your home or business’s roof in suitable condition in order to protect the value of your investment if you go to sell.

Farris Roofing has the knowledge to get the work done correctly, no matter the size, difficulty level or pitch of your roof. We do not subcontract any of our work and our skilled roofers are all business employees.

[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][et_pb_column type=”1_2″ _builder_version=”4.16″ _module_preset=”default” global_colors_info=”{}”][et_pb_text _builder_version=”4.16″ text_font=”Heebo||||||||” text_text_color=”#000000″ text_font_size=”17px” text_line_height=”1.9em” link_font=”|||on|||||” link_text_color=”#BB1C29″ header_font=”Poppins|700||on|||||” header_text_align=”center” header_text_color=”#1E73B9″ header_font_size=”5vw” text_orientation=”center” max_width=”850px” module_alignment=”center” text_font_size_tablet=”18px” text_font_size_phone=”15px” text_font_size_last_edited=”on|phone” header_font_size_tablet=”5vw” header_font_size_phone=”9vw” header_font_size_last_edited=”on|phone” locked=”off” global_colors_info=”{}”]

Consider a Metal Roof if you are looking for a durable roof that can hold up longer than a traditional shingle roof. Metal Roofs are becoming more common on residential properties and are already used often for commercial properties. Call us to discuss your needs and wants related to your roof and we would be happy to talk you through your various material options. 

We don’t cut corners when it comes to our work or our commitment to our customers. In everything we do, we strive for excellence. We keep projects moving on schedule to meet all of our clients’ needs. When you choose Farris Roofing to inspect and repair/replace your roof, you’re getting top-notch service.

[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][/et_pb_row][et_pb_row custom_padding_last_edited=”on|phone” _builder_version=”4.16″ _module_preset=”default” custom_padding_tablet=”” custom_padding_phone=”0px||0px||true|false” global_colors_info=”{}”][et_pb_column type=”4_4″ _builder_version=”4.16″ _module_preset=”default” global_colors_info=”{}”][et_pb_text _builder_version=”4.16″ text_font=”Heebo||||||||” text_text_color=”#000000″ text_font_size=”17px” text_line_height=”1.9em” header_font=”Poppins|700||on|||||” header_text_align=”left” header_text_color=”#1E73B9″ header_font_size=”4.2vw” header_3_font=”||on||||||” header_3_text_align=”center” header_3_text_color=”#000000″ header_4_font=”||on||||||” header_4_text_align=”center” header_4_text_color=”#BB1C29″ header_4_font_size=”20px” header_4_line_height=”1.4em” custom_padding=”5px||5px||true|false” text_font_size_tablet=”18px” text_font_size_phone=”15px” text_font_size_last_edited=”on|phone” header_font_size_tablet=”5vw” header_font_size_phone=”9vw” header_font_size_last_edited=”on|phone” header_4_font_size_tablet=”20px” header_4_font_size_phone=”20px” header_4_font_size_last_edited=”on|desktop” locked=”off” global_colors_info=”{}”]

Metal roofs are made from aluminum, an extremely tough material, so they will not rust and cannot be broken down by the elements.

Call us today or get a free estimate by clicking the link below.
